g.text: B The entire normal bundle glues
Transport the metric, then the full spin-c module.
Retain every line phase, torsion twist and stable grading.
One whole family also retains bordisms and sphere clutch bundles.

Hence BG ≃ V with the whole normal bundle τ.
This classifies cocycle concordance, with actual arrows retained.
